name: app.antigravityreset/antigravity-reset
title: Antigravity Reset
description: Live Google Antigravity quota reset tracker, history, intervals, and multilingual announcements.

tools.name: get_latest_reset
tools.description: Get the most recent official Google Antigravity quota reset announcement from @_mohansolo, elapsed time since reset, and overall statistics.

locale.description: Output locale for localized text (default: en).

tools.name: list_resets
tools.description: List Google Antigravity quota reset announcements with optional filtering by model name, reset_type (regular or all), locale, and limit.

locale.description: Output locale for localized text (default: en).

model.description: Filter by model name (e.g. Gemini, Argon) or 'all' for all-model resets.

reset_type.description: Filter by reset scope: 'regular' (single model) or 'all' (multi-model / all models).

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-50, default: 20).

tools.name: search_resets
tools.description: Search verified Antigravity quota reset announcements by keyword across English text, localized text, and model names.

query.description: Keyword to search for (e.g. Thanksgiving, Argon, Neon, caching).

locale.description: Output locale for localized text (default: en).

tools.name: get_reset_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate statistics on Google Antigravity quota resets: total count, average interval days, longest wait days, breakdown by model/scope, and monitor status.
